items.source: A Future handle returned from the proxy will be an actual asynchronous (Completable)Future that can be used to track the result of the asynchronous method execution. However, since the target method needs to implement the same signature, it will have to return a temporary Future handle that just passes a value after computation in the execution thread: typically through CompletableFuture.completedFuture(Object). The provided value will be exposed to the caller through the actual asynchronous Future handle at runtime.
items.translation: 代理返回的 `Future` 句柄将是一个实际的异步 `(Completable)Future`，可用于跟踪异步方法执行的结果。然而，由于目标方法需要实现相同的签名，它必须返回一个临时的 `Future` 句柄，该句柄仅在执行线程中完成计算后传递值：通常通过 CompletableFuture.completedFuture(Object) 实现。提供的值将在运行时通过实际的异步 `Future` 句柄暴露给调用者。

items.source: In terms of target method signatures, any parameter types are supported. However, the return type is constrained to either void or Future. In the latter case, you may declare the more specific CompletableFuture type which allows for richer interaction with the asynchronous task and for immediate composition with further processing steps.
items.translation: 在目标方法签名方面，支持任何参数类型。然而，返回类型仅限于 void 或 Future。在后一种情况下，您可以声明更具体的 CompletableFuture 类型，该类型允许与异步任务进行更丰富的交互，并能够立即与后续处理步骤组合。

items.source: May be used to determine the target executor to be used when executing the asynchronous operation(s), matching the qualifier value (or the bean name) of a specific Executor or TaskExecutor bean definition.
items.translation: 可能用于确定执行异步操作时要使用的目标执行器，匹配特定 Executor 或 TaskExecutor bean 定义的限定符值（或 bean 名称）。

items.source: Can also be used at the type level, in which case all the type's methods are considered as asynchronous. Note, however, that @Async is not supported on methods declared within a @Configuration class.
items.translation: 也可以在类型级别使用，此时该类型的所有方法均被视为异步。但请注意，@Async 不支持在 @Configuration 类中声明的方法上使用。

items.source: When specified in a class-level @Async annotation, indicates that the given executor should be used for all methods within the class. Method-level use of Async#value always overrides any qualifier value configured at the class level.
items.translation: 在类级别的 `@Async` 注解中指定时，表示应使用给定的执行器来运行该类中的所有方法。方法级别使用 `Async#value` 始终会覆盖在类级别配置的任意限定符值。

items.source: The qualifier value will be resolved dynamically if supplied as a SpEL expression (for example, "#{environment['myExecutor']}") or a property placeholder (for example, "${my.app.myExecutor}").
items.translation: 如果提供的是 SpEL 表达式（例如，"#{environment['myExecutor']}"）或属性占位符（例如，"${my.app.myExecutor}"），限定符值将动态解析。

items.source: A qualifier value for the specified asynchronous operation(s).
items.translation: 指定异步操作的限定符值。
